build_drop_path_layer: build a DropPath nn.Module with a given drop probability for stochastic depth in residual blocks
create_drop_path_function: create a function that applies stochastic depth dropout to a tensor with configurable drop probability
test_drop_path_function: test the drop_path function by passing a tensor and verifying it returns unchanged when drop_prob is zero
test_DropPath_forward: test the DropPath module forward pass to confirm it applies stochastic depth during training mode
review_drop_path_implementation: review the drop_path function and DropPath class for correct stochastic depth implementation per sample
